) on Tuesday appointed Ingrid Zhang as Chief Executive Officer, effective September 15, 2026.
Zhang succeeds Alan Bash, who has served as interim CEO since July 2026.

Most recently, Zhang served as Chief Commercial Officer for Novartis International. During her tenure at Novartis, she also led the company's China business and innovative medicines organization. Earlier in her career, she held leadership positions at AstraZeneca, Pfizer, and McKinsey & Company.

title: Legend Biotech appoints Ingrid Zhang as CEO
